title: Update storage and routine logic for multi-type exercises
acceptance_criteria: Storage validation and normalization accept arbitrary non-empty type values and multi-valued type arrays.
Legacy persisted scalar Strength/Stretch values migrate to the canonical representation without dropping valid exercise records.
Routine selection matches an exercise when the selected group type is one of that exercise's type values.
Filtering, target-muscle/tag derivation, routine regeneration, favorites, snapshots, and storage cloning remain immutable and type-safe.
Evidence, source URLs, and other import-only fields are not persisted in the user-facing storage model.
